what: first commit in a new project failed: no git identity
why: studio-new doesn't set user.name/email in the project repo and none is configured globally

guard.ref: studio-new sets the project's git identity

what: airship fins rolled under 1 degree, all on one side; rings and cables in the wrong plane
why: angle converted to radians twice; torus/cylinder rotated about the wrong axis; the worker's self-check didn't measure bounds

guard.ref: Blender tickets give expected per-object bounds and the worker must print them

what: every glb held all six objects; plume started at x=0
why: export_scene.gltf without use_selection=True; poly spline keeps its default point at the origin when points.add(n) is used

guard.ref: AGENTS.md Blender section: use_selection=True on per-object exports; points.add(n-1)

what: step 2 worker timed out at 40 min (context 97K)
why: one ticket mixed two new Blender scripts, an edit of a third and two previews

guard.ref: one new Blender script per ticket

why: 0-255 colours passed to su.color_material, which takes 0-1 floats (known slip, again)

what: thick ink band along the horizon
why: first-difference depth edges fire on grazing ground; a 1.5-texel offset is point-sampled as 1 and 2 texels, so even the Laplacian of 1/depth wasn't 0 on a plane

guard.ref: post-process edges: integer texel offsets, slope-normalised Laplacian of 1/depth (docs/unreal.md)

what: custom-depth proxy hid the objects inside the glass
why: render_in_main_pass=False still writes the depth prepass; render_in_depth_pass=False is needed too. Material.allow_custom_depth_writes doesn't exist in 5.8 Python
ticket gave scale 4000-9000 for a ~1 m rock (meant 40-90 m, wrote cm)

guard.ref: tickets state target sizes in metres and let the worker derive scale from measured bounds

what: fire core seen through the envelope rendered pale peach
why: custom-depth proxy kept the airship's translucent envelope slot (never written to custom depth), and su.color_material feeds sRGB hex as linear

guard.ref: custom_depth_proxy forces an opaque material on all slots; color_material(srgb=True) option

what: three Gemma timeouts in a row (steps 2, 2-retry, 3)
why: worker idles for 20+ min after its last tool call at 90-98K context

guard.ref: studio-worker: stall detector (no tool call for 5 min -> stop and report)

what: a ghost copy of the airship stayed at the start position
why: custom-depth proxy attached while its component was Static; set_mobility(MOVABLE) came after attach_to_actor, and UE silently keeps a static child in place
